originalSourceText:
Q.6   Given
                                𝑓(𝑥, 𝑦) = 3𝑥2 + 2𝑥𝑦+ 𝑦2
      Find the gradient at (1, 2).

      (A) [8, 4]

      (B) [10, 6]

      (C) [6, 10]

      (D) [12, 8]

       Explanation: (B)

      Refer Slide: 9 of Lecture: 3

                         ∂𝑓         ∂𝑓
                   ∂𝑥= 6𝑥+ 2𝑦, ∂𝑦= 2𝑥+ 2𝑦
      At (1, 2):

                           ∂𝑓
                     ∂𝑥= 6(1) + 2(2) = 10
                           ∂𝑓
                     ∂𝑦= 2(1) + 2(2) = 6
       Therefore,

                                  ∇𝑓(1,2) = [10 ] .
                                       6
